feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring hindi na siya ang lead; kumpirmahin muna.
feedback_by_option.en: That person may no longer be the lead; confirm first.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kapag kumpirmado ang team at channel, makararating ang pangangailangan sa may pananagutan.
feedback_by_option.en: A confirmed team and channel mean the need reaches someone responsible.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring luma ang listahan, at dapat pribado ang pangalan at detalye ng kalusugan.
feedback_by_option.en: The list may be old, and names and health details must stay private.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi lumang roster ang batayan ng team ngayon.
feedback_by_option.en: This may harm or delay help: an old roster does not set today's team.

feedback_by_option.fil: Sa maikling handover na may oras, masusundan ang pangangailangan.
feedback_by_option.en: A short handover with the time recorded keeps the need traceable.

feedback_by_option.fil: Kung walang pagtanggap, walang nakaaalam kung natanggap ang pangangailangan.
feedback_by_option.en: Without acknowledgement, no one knows the need was received.
